name: lingo
description: Learn a language while you code: shows a translation under your prompts and Claude's replies, and a live preview while you type. Translates with Claude or any OpenAI-compatible model (Ollama, OpenRouter, ...).

targetLanguage.title: Lingo · Target language
targetLanguage.description: The language you're learning. Messages in any other language get a translation into it. Off turns Lingo off.

nativeLanguage.title: Lingo · Native language
nativeLanguage.description: Your own language: explanations and word notes are written in it.

previewWhileTyping.title: Lingo · Preview while typing
previewWhileTyping.description: Show a translation of your draft above the prompt box.

polishWhileTyping.title: Lingo · Suggest fixes while typing
polishWhileTyping.description: When your draft is already in the language you're learning, suggest a more natural version above the prompt box; Use puts it in the box.

translatePrompts.title: Lingo · Translate my prompts
translatePrompts.description: Show a translation under your own messages.

translateReplies.title: Lingo · Translate Claude's replies
translateReplies.description: Show a translation under Claude's text. Tool calls and code are never translated.

foldTranslations.title: Lingo · Fold translations
foldTranslations.description: Start each translation folded: nothing is translated (or paid for) until you open it with ▸ Translate, or /lingo show for the latest reply. Turn off to translate every message as it appears.

saveWords.title: Lingo · Save words as flashcards
saveWords.description: Save the key words of a previewed draft you send as flashcards. Review them with /lingo review.

provider.title: Lingo · Provider
provider.description: Who translates: Claude (through Claude Code, your account) or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint, such as a local Ollama, LM Studio, OpenRouter or Groq.

translationModel.title: Lingo · Translation model
translationModel.description: The model that translates. With Claude: an alias (haiku) or a full id (claude-haiku-4-5). With an OpenAI-compatible provider: its model name (gemma4:cloud is a good pick on Ollama).

providerBaseUrl.title: Lingo · Provider URL
providerBaseUrl.description: With an OpenAI-compatible provider: the API base, ending in /v1 (http://localhost:11434/v1 for Ollama, https://openrouter.ai/api/v1, https://api.groq.com/openai/v1).

providerApiKey.title: Lingo · Provider API key
providerApiKey.description: With an OpenAI-compatible provider: its API key, sent as a Bearer token. Leave empty for a local Ollama. Stored in plain text in settings.json.
